changelog: The emulator found four things that the test suite could not, all fixed: the settings screen crashed the app the moment it was opened, a failed connection showed an empty inbox with no explanation, every message without an attachment was labelled with the word "null", and an update that could not be installed left no way to try again. The update check now also runs as soon as the app knows the server, and it has a ceiling so a server that does not answer cannot hold it up.
